01 / ABOUT ME

Bookkeeping with a
digital business mindset.

I am a QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper with 7 months of practical experience supporting accurate and organized financial recordkeeping.

My hands-on bookkeeping experience includes bank and credit card reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expenses, sales, financial reporting, and general ledger work.

Alongside my bookkeeping experience, I am currently developing my GoHighLevel skills through training in CRM, sales funnels, automation, and workflows.
